Join Orbotix as Embedded Engineer - Brașov, Romania 
 About us 
 Orbotix is a defense tech company specializing in autonomous drones, robotics, and advanced AI. We combine cutting-edge engineering with deep domain knowledge to build high-performance systems for mission-critical environments.
 Role Overview 
 An Embedded Engineer will design, develop, and maintain the low-level firmware and software that power our hardware platforms. You will team up closely with our hardware, RTL, and software engineers to build high-quality, reliable embedded solutions from the ground up.
 Location: Brașov
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Model: Hybrid
 Key Responsibilities 
Write, test, and optimize embedded C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers, SoCs, and RTOS-based platforms;
Work together with the hardware and RTL teams to map out interface specs, design requirements, and system architecture;
Develop and maintain low-level device drivers and communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet);
Help create and maintain clear technical documentation, including firmware specs, architecture guides, and test plans.
 Must-Have Qualifications 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field;
3 - 5 years of hands-on experience developing bare-metal or RTOS-based embedded firmware in C/C++;
A strong grasp of microcontroller/SoC architectures, memory management, and reading hardware schematics;
Experience with lab debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD) and embedded toolchains;
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities;
English at B1/B2 level (written and spoken).
 What We Offer: Flexible working hours
Regular Vacation
Day off on your birthday
A multicultural and mission-driven work environment
 Application Process: 
 To apply, please send your CV to recruiting@orbotix.tech
 How does the recruitment process look like? 
HR screening
Cultural fit interview with HR
Technical interview
Final interview with the COO
Job offer
 We aim to keep the process clear, human, and efficient - and we’re always happy to improve.
